scope: per-target-prompt ledger accumulated across the 2026-09-18 empirical evaluation (iters 1–5 + holdout)

entries.example: Passing a bad-state predicate as --invariant produced a spurious State-0 violation; the executor initially read it as a finding.
entries.generalFixRule: To look for a state where `bad` holds, check `not(bad)`; a violation is the witness. Record the polarity used.
entries.status: fixed in iter2 (formal-methods.md §C); used correctly in iters 2–5

entries.example: Captured console output was truncated; the witness position became uncertain until traces were exported.
entries.generalFixRule: Save every retained witness with --out-itf (or equivalent) and cite the file; console output is not evidence.
entries.status: fixed in iter2; executors cite .itf.json files in iters 2–5

entries.example: Under a no-external-send constraint, whether a cached Apalache distribution could be used had to be decided ad hoc (PATH vs tool cache, localhost endpoint, usage stats).
entries.generalFixRule: Confirm from CLI output, startup log or configuration that the backend is already local (no download), endpoints are localhost, and usage statistics are off; record the surface checked.
entries.status: fixed in iter2, refined in iter3/iter5; executors record surfaces and skip availability probing when permission is denied

entries.pattern: Two output contracts, no declared default
entries.example: reporting.md has a full finding card and a compact format; executors produced three different output shapes.
entries.generalFixRule: Declare which format is the deliverable and which is the internal record.
entries.status: fixed in iter3; compact output cited in iters 4–5

entries.pattern: Absence findings lack a quote form
entries.example: A missing-source/in-scope-absent finding cannot carry a verbatim `quote` in source_refs.
entries.generalFixRule: Separate absence evidence (searched_scope, nearest clause, documents checked) from quotation fields; never fabricate a quote.
entries.status: fixed in iter3 (searched_scope/missing_sources guidance); no recurrence

entries.example: Apalache failed with assignment/encoding errors (e.g. `Missing assignments to`, `used before it is assigned`), which look like model errors but are backend constraints.
entries.generalFixRule: Reproduce in a minimal module, classify as backend encoding constraint or model error, record the workaround and scope in limits, report only from the repaired model; inductive checks commonly need a labeled type invariant.
entries.status: fixed in iter4; handled without misclassification in iters 4–5

entries.pattern: Zero selected checks read as a pass
entries.example: `quint test` exit 0 with no selected test; a deliberately failing control named without the `*Test` suffix was not run.
entries.generalFixRule: Confirm the check actually ran (non-empty selection, non-vacuous invariant, satisfiable model); keep one deliberately failing control; an exit code of 0 with no selected test is not a pass.
entries.status: fixed in iter4 bullet; recognized in iter5

entries.example: Quint run bodies and .then/.expect chains had to be discovered by trial and error; runs must start from init and default actions are init/step.
entries.generalFixRule: Provide a minimal complete example for the target tool language, with init/step defaults and test selection conventions, before writing the slice.
entries.status: fixed in iter4 (verified minimal slice in formal-methods.md); no syntax retries in iters 4–5

entries.example: Whether minimal meant fewest steps or formal minimality was undecidable.
entries.generalFixRule: Define smallest as the fewest events that still produce the differing observation; not a claim of formal minimality.

entries.example: Whether 'up to 12 candidate probes' counts candidates, findings, or ledger rows.
entries.generalFixRule: State what is being counted (candidates generated vs findings reported) wherever numbers appear.
entries.status: SKILL.md fixed in iter4; reporting.md coverage-ledger clause added post-loop

entries.example: When sending was forbidden, whether tool availability should still be probed was unclear.
entries.generalFixRule: Tool availability and permission are separate conditions; when permission is denied, record not run without probing availability.
entries.status: fixed in iter5; followed in iter5 A/C

entries.example: Two parallel `quint verify` runs collided on localhost:8822 ('Address already in use').
entries.generalFixRule: Some local backends bind a fixed port; serialize model-checker invocations instead of running them in parallel.

entries.pattern: Standard unflushed output during parallel verify
entries.example: Concurrent checkers also interleaved standard output, complicating log attribution.
entries.generalFixRule: Redirect each checker's output to its own log file when serialization still allows overlapping processes.
entries.status: covered by the same post-loop serialization clause; no separate change

entries.example: The skill allows proposals; whether a proposal may look like replacement text was unclear.
entries.generalFixRule: Keep proposals as labeled resolution options; boundaries already forbid rewriting the source.
entries.status: adjudicated no-change (existing boundaries and 'label as proposal' suffice)

entries.pattern: Single observation contract vs persistence effects
entries.example: When the source declares one observable (e.g. notification count), whether a DLQ/log effect can serve as the differing observation was unclear.
entries.generalFixRule: reporting.md already allows an 'output/effect'; gap-catalog prioritization already names persistence. Use justified effects, not internal state.

entries.pattern: Indeterminate (near-0.5) Jev answers have no designated bucket
entries.example: A contradiction assertion returned 0.50; the executor correctly treated it as undecided but had to decide where an indeterminate answer belongs.
entries.generalFixRule: Treat an answer near 0.5 as undetermined: count it for neither side, and report the indeterminacy itself rather than a lean.

entries.pattern: Probe budget overflow has no stopping rule
entries.example: On a 43-line source the executor generated 15 candidates against the 12-candidate budget and chose to truncate and report the overage itself.
entries.generalFixRule: When a listing budget binds on a small source, prioritize by consequence and report the overage; the existing 'report what was left unexplored' covers the outcome.

entries.example: Shared scratch directories and the meta-report's 'Deliverable' field duplicated the reply body.
entries.generalFixRule: Not skill defects; these belong to the evaluation harness prompt.
